Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Review

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Review
public class Review extends Object
A buyer's rating and optional comment on the seller of one completed deal (Review in the domain class diagram; UC10). The buyer cannot change it afterwards (UC10 Special Requirement 3), so the rating and comment are final. The buyer and seller are found through the reviewed offer.
